text:
Tara Nguyen: Quick request for the benchmark launch comms — need a compact, accessibility-first asset bundle. Scope: 1 hero web banner (1600x420) with optional Lottie + GIF fallback, 3 email headers (600x200 / 480x160 / 320x120), four social crops (1:1, 16:9, 9:16, story), and a single-slide flowmap SVG (webinar -> MQL -> SDR -> Demo -> Trial) that clearly labels Hosted / Dedicated / Private and has toggleable stat callouts. Deadline: next Mon 10am PT.

Benji Cole: Copy can do. I'll post 3 short hooks + 2 CTA variants by tomorrow. Tone: practical, slightly urgent.

Aria Singh: Motion constraints: keep loops <=6s, provide reduced-motion PNGs. Dark-mode variants required. On the flowmap: sales wants optional ms and $/1k token callouts as separate SVG layers.

Brand Review: Use palette-v3 tokens only. Headline = Inter Display, body = Inter. No neon accent colors. Contrast: body >= 4.5:1. Provide alt text drafts and caption text for animations.

DesignOps Bot: Design slot reserved for Aria Mon 8am PT (2h). I'll create an export checklist and remind for brand sweep.

Benji Cole: Hooks posted: "Benchmark the true cost of latency"; "Inference that scales without surprises"; "See latency vs unit cost". CTAs: "Register now" / "View benchmark". I'll add alt text for each asset once comps are up.

Aria Singh: I'll start comps tonight. ETA initial Figma pass Mon 2pm PT. File naming: [asset]-[channel]-[size]-v1 (e.g., hero-web-1600x420-v1.png). Will include manifest.json inside the Figma with export specs. Figma link when ready: https://www.figma.com/file/EXAMPLE/benchmark-launch-bundle

Tara Nguyen: Great—please call out any accessibility tradeoffs in Figma comments (motion, contrast). Brand Review will perform final sweep within 24h of the Figma link. Thanks! :rocket:
